task.news: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged.
task.expressive: A little change in the weekly rhythm! Update the listing so everyone finds the programme on Wednesday.
task.restrained: The programme now airs on Wednesday. Update the listing so everyone finds the programme on Wednesday.
task.user: Nela moved the radio programme from Tuesday to Wednesday. The broadcast time, duration and reception are unchanged. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences. Make the emotional tone vivid and fitting to the news.

response: Nela's decision to shift the radio programme to Wednesday is a welcome change, ensuring that listeners can still enjoy the show without any disruption to their schedules. As for the next step, it would be beneficial for Nela to inform her audience about the new broadcast time and remind them to tune in, ensuring that they don't miss out on the exciting content.
